description:
Aunt Yunjung had always protected Sanghun since he was a child. Then one day, with the news of his aunt's marriage, he moved to Seoul. Time passed, and Sanghun became a university student. As he pondered where to spend his vacation, news of his aunt, whom he hadn't seen in a long time, reached him. Sanghun arrived at his aunt's house with excitement and anticipation. His aunt, who opened the door and came out, was wrapped in only a shower towel, looking at Sanghun and welcoming him happily...
